results.overview: For as long as he can remember, Ichigo Kurosaki has been able to see ghosts. But when he meets Rukia, a Soul Reaper who battles evil spirits known as Hollows, he finds his life is changed forever. Now, with a newfound wealth of spiritual energy, Ichigo discovers his true calling: to protect the living and the dead from evil.
results.name: Bleach

results.overview: Concentrated Bleach is a fan-edit that aims to  annihilate padding and as many filler scenes as possible  to closely resemble the Bleach manga. The edit also revamps the subtitles, and is available in both Sub and Dub.
results.name: Concentrated Bleach

results.overview: Basketball legends from past and present go head to head in a one-on-one game, but mostly just talk trash until one triumphs the victor!
results.name: The Portal - Bleacher Report
